A '''Human''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] and was aware of both [[Sunry]] and [[Elassa Huros]]'s true identities&mdash;he was an agent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] intelligence community and she was a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. While the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was investigating Huros's murder by Sunry, the man approached the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and told him to search the Republic and the Sith embassies in [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]] for more information.
